limitations: Whole-server decision: the whole job (image_pack, VLM, result_format) runs on one server, GGG or NNN; not DAG placement, no inter-server stage partitioning, no mixed route. The earlier GNG/GNN DAG pilot is separate frozen evidence.
G = ser0003 GB10 GPU (BF16), N = ser0004 Mobilint ARIES (W4V8), source dev0003 (JPEG/NPY replay from an edge Pod, not a verified live sensor stream). Different precisions; quality not evaluated.

One process block (one GPU Pod, one Mobilint Pod), one input cal-3733440, one observation per (condition, server), at most four main jobs: a low-load single-request diagnosis; no statistical superiority, p95, capacity or goodput claim.

fixed_gpu is a fixed GPU-first rule over the resource-eligible servers, not the actual kube-scheduler; fixed_npu is a reference. compute_only/compute_network are simple argmin baselines over two servers, not a new algorithm.

npu_slow2 is the unchanged net_control.py 2 Mbit/s tbf on the owned gateway egress toward the NPU Pod IP only (cloud=[N], edge=[]); G and source replies unshaped; both servers reached through the same gateway in both conditions. Not a measured physical WAN/topology; no shared-bottleneck claim.

Network cost is the application-path probe RTT of a size-matched synthetic payload (random bytes, the raw NPY byte count; not the sensor content) over the request route (HTTP/relay processing included), not a pure network time; derived effective throughput is not a link capacity or the configured rate. Main jobs used the frozen sensor input.
Same-host stage HTTP is part of the server processing estimate; T1/T3 are host-CPU support stages, only T2 runs neural inference on CUDA or Mobilint (no CPU fallback).

Policy labels selecting the same server share ONE observation (aliases), never independent samples. The chooser was not forced to switch: an unchanged choice across conditions is reported as observed.
